title: PanTS + PANORAMA staged readiness pass
scope: Finish mixed-source setup; no long training, source edits, public publishing, or scheduled AI checks
reuse: PanTS 1408-case cache/1333 train/75 development qualification; PANORAMA completed CT/union audit and all prior holds

stages.work: Render CT/mask overlays for at least 10 expert PDAC, 10 automatic PDAC, 10 non-PDAC, all three manual anomalies, every repeated-subject family and observed scanner groups; include the resampling-loss case
stages.gate: Review each selected case, record coverage/crop defects and dispositions; expand review for systematic defects. Rendering is not approval.

stages.work: Build CT-only canonical exact hashes and a versioned physical fingerprint; plant at least 20 transformations covering gzip/header, orientation, rounding, resampling and crop/pad changes. Include both-source distractors and report candidate burden.
stages.gate: At least 19/20 source retrieval, no hidden failures, reviewed negative controls and manageable candidate burden; freeze parameters before full scan.

stages.work: Inventory original PanTS train/development/test CTs and import-clean PANORAMA CTs; fingerprint with bounded memory, source hashes and role evidence; retrieve cross-source candidates
stages.gate: Complete protected-role coverage or explicit blocker; exact matches excluded, approximate candidates adjudicated, unresolved candidates quarantined. Test labels/inference/evaluation forbidden.

stages.work: Preserve PanTS roles and all original exclusions; assemble eligible expert-PDAC primary pool, separate optional automatic pool and subject groups; version manifests and issue dispositions
stages.gate: No unresolved QC/duplicate issues in admitted studies; unknown generic-lesion cases never become negatives; no silent cohort shrinkage.

stages.work: Add source-aware prepared-cache provider with PanTS pancreas-only and PANORAMA union transforms; validate per-member source/geometry/annotation provenance
stages.gate: Synthetic regression/role guards, source-specific batch tests and verified derived-cache hashes pass; frozen PanTS cache remains unchanged.

stages.work: Bounded CUDA test exercising PanTS positive/reference-empty, approved expert PANORAMA, separately disclosed automatic transport case, repeated-subject cases, validation and checkpoint/independent backup/cold restore
stages.gate: At most 12 producer updates plus one cold continuation update, 75 unchanged PanTS development evaluations, no test model access, 30-minute watchdog/12GiB memory/100GiB free-space floors; no automatic long run.

first_dispatch: Quality and duplicate-calibration evidence generation only, then explicit review-needed stop. Later stages are planned, not automatically authorized by file presence.
failure_policy: Stop on source/hash/storage/power/resource faults; preserve logs and artifacts; no retries or silent repairs. Case-level technical holds remain explicit.
definition_of_done: All gates passed with evidence, combined frozen configuration and mixed smoke verified; ready for a separately chosen long experiment, not a model-quality or clean SuPreM benchmark claim.
